sections.title: Borrowers hear from the broker before they have to chase
sections.body: The operating model is built around stage-based communication. When a file moves, the borrower gets the right update, the broker sees the next task, and the CRM timeline stays readable.
bullets: Retail home loan onboarding and document request journeys.
Commercial file updates for structure review, submission, and lender response.
Follow-up tasks tied to missing documents and key dates.

sections.title: Document control without spreadsheet drift
sections.body: Each application carries its own checklist, ownership, and status. Brokers and admins can see what is missing, what is already acceptable, and what is holding submission back.
bullets: Checklist items stored against every loan application.
Broker reminders for incomplete items before submission.
Simple internal visibility across retail and commercial files.

sections.title: Lifecycle communication that protects the trail book
sections.body: The mailer side is not limited to a one-off campaign. The core library covers onboarding, nurture, review, refinance, cross-sell, and winback messaging so the book keeps compounding after settlement.
bullets: Rate review, repricing, and fixed-rate expiry outreach.
